subject: SKU allocation & cloud backstop for Q4 Redwood deal
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: procurement@calypsosys.com; sales@orioncloud.com
Cc: dev@redwood.com, ben@redwood.com, marissa@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SKU allocation & cloud backstop for Q4 Redwood deal

Hi Matthew / Calypso team,

Quick ask: we have a commercial close coming with Nimbus Health (deal RNW-0921) that is tightly coupled to specific GPU SKUs (A100-80GB equivalent, 3-slot). Their initial ramp needs ~180 cards reserved across two tranches (80 / 100) with first tranche live in ~10 weeks. Lead times on these SKUs are the gating factor for us.

Can Calypso:
- Hold the SKU lane for RNW-0921 with a quote lock window through 6/30/2027?
- Confirm earliest ship windows and whether you can commit to a partial shipment cadence (we’d prefer staggered shipments to match our rollout).
- Provide a deposit/hold pricing option and what the minimum PO/commitment looks like.

We want a written lane reservation rather than just a verbal. If full OEM fulfillment misses our internal onramp, we intend to use a cloud backstop (Orion Cloud) for the first 6–8 weeks — which means we’ll need coordination on both the OEM PO and a cloud capacity reservation/short-term plan.

I attached a short capacity sheet (deal_capacity_requirements.xlsx) and the draft mutual action plan for reference.

Thanks — aim is to lock the procurement route this week so we can add firm milestones to the customer MLP.

— Maya Srinivasan
Sr. Manager, Strategic Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Matthew Ho <matt.ho@calypsosys.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: dev@redwood.com, ben@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU allocation & cloud backstop for Q4 Redwood deal

Maya — thanks for the clarity and the sheet. Quick summary from our side:

1) SKU reservation: we can place an internal reservation on the SKU lane for RNW-0921 through 2027-06-30 if we receive a signed reservation agreement with a 20% deposit. That locks pricing and nominal lead time assumptions for 14 calendar days post-signature.

2) Lead times: current OEM lead estimates for the 3-slot A100-80GB-equivalent are 9–11 weeks from PO to shipment manifest for full production runs. We can do a staggered fulfillment (partial shipment) but that incurs separate freight windows and split-invoice handling.

3) Backfill / cloud: we have prior relationships with Orion Cloud and can coordinate the manifest/transfer window. If Redwood publishes a PO and indicates a cloud fallback, we can time partial shipments to align with Orion reservations.

I attached our quote (Calypso_OEM_SkuQuote_RNW-0921.pdf) — it contains the lane reservation clause, deposit term, and proposed shipping cadence (80 units by week 11, remaining 100 by week 15).

If you want us to hold without deposit, we can do a soft hold for up to 72 hours while the finance team routes the deposit, but we cannot extend beyond that without commercial coverage.

Regards,
Matthew Ho
Director, Hardware Partnerships
Calypso Systems

Attachment: Calypso_OEM_SkuQuote_RNW-0921.pdf
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU allocation & cloud backstop for Q4 Redwood deal

Looping the rest of the enablement/ops thread. A few concrete options from an engineering/ops perspective:

- Option A (Hybrid): Accept Calypso staggered shipments. Reserve the first tranche on-prem and run the initial customer traffic on Orion reserved VMs for 6–8 weeks. Pros: lower overall cost, consistent latency once SKU arrives. Cons: double ops effort during cutover.

- Option B (Cloud-first): Use Orion for the first 3 months, then cutover to Calypso hardware when full capacity arrives. Pros: removes risk of partial performance hitting customer SLAs; Cons: higher token costs initially.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: can finance approve a 20% deposit to secure the 6/30 lock? If we miss 6/30 the soft hold expires.
- Marissa: Prod readiness — how long between receipt of tranche-1 and being able to surface it to customer traffic (CI, burn-in, image bake)? Estimate was 5 business days if we have staging windows free.

If finance pushes back on deposit, we can propose a phased deposit tied to shipment milestones (10% now, 10% on first manifest).

— Dev
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU allocation & cloud backstop for Q4 Redwood deal

Agree with Dev. Finance is OK to proceed with a phased deposit structure but needs the PO draft and exact bank instructions to run a quick approval. We should avoid open-ended deposits tied to unspecified shipping cadence.

Action items I will take:
- Review the Calypso quote and produce a PO draft with explicit milestone payment schedule. (See attached PO_RNW-0921-draft.pdf)
- Request Treasury to pre-approve expedited wire for the first tranche payment.

Marissa — please confirm the bake window availability so I can match payment milestones to actual onboarding capacity.

— Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_RNW-0921-draft.pdf
From: Matthew Ho <matt.ho@calypsosys.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: dev@redwood.com, marissa@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU allocation & cloud backstop for Q4 Redwood deal

Ben / Maya — appreciate the quick turnaround. Calypso confirms:

- We will accept a phased deposit schedule (10% on reservation, 10% on first manifest) and hold the SKU lane once we receive the signed PO.
- We will prepare a shipping manifest for the first 80 units targetting week 11; carrier and incoterms included in the final quote.
- If the PO arrives before 2027-06-30 we will honor the quote lock.

We will also coordinate with Orion Cloud for a short-term reserved capacity handoff; I’ve looped their account team in the BCC. Please send the signed PO to procurement@calypsosys.com and wire details will be in the invoice.

Matthew Ho
Director, Hardware Partnerships
Calypso Systems

Note: forwarded manifest and carrier details will be provided once PO is live.
